```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
save <- here("Retinorecipient","OPN")
dir.create(save, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
data <- read_excel(
  here("data", "rawdata.xlsx"),
  sheet = "opn fig6e")


subtype_cols <- c(
  "gfp_only",
  "gfp_spp1_calb1",
  "gfp_spp1_meis2",
  "gfp_calb1",
  "gfp_meis2"
)

first_col <- names(data)[1]

opn_clean <- data %>%
  filter(.data[[first_col]] != "subtype") %>%    # drop the metadata row
  mutate(across(all_of(subtype_cols), as.numeric))


subtype_totals <- opn_clean %>%
  select(all_of(subtype_cols)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
               names_to = "subtype_orig",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(
    subtype = case_when(
      subtype_orig == "gfp_only" ~ "c23_c39",
      subtype_orig == "gfp_spp1_calb1" ~ "c43",
      subtype_orig == "gfp_spp1_meis2" ~ "c45",
      subtype_orig == "gfp_calb1" ~ "c30",
      subtype_orig == "gfp_meis2" ~ "c34",
      TRUE ~ subtype_orig
    ),
    percentage = count / sum(count) * 100
  )

custom_colors <- c(
  "c23_c39" = "#B0B0B0",  # light grey
  "c30"     = "#999999",  # medium grey
  "c34"     = "#808080",  # darker grey
  "c43"     = "#009967",  # dark teal blue
  "c45"     = "#006B99" # green
)


opnplot <- ggplot(subtype_totals, aes(x = subtype, y = percentage, fill = subtype)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 10
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Observed frequency %",
    title = NULL
  ) +   
  theme_classic() +
    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL) +
  theme(
      text = element_text(size = 30),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm"))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,80))

opnplot

ggsave("opninjection.pdf",
       plot = opnplot,
       path = save,
       device = pdf,
       width = 10,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300)

```
